import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;

    static class Edge {
        int src, dst, backIdx, flow, capacity;

        Edge() {
            src = 0; dst = 0; backIdx = 0; flow = 0; capacity = 0;
        }

        Edge(int s, int d, int b, int f, int c) {
            src = s; dst = d; backIdx = b; flow = f; capacity = c;
        }

        int remaining() {
            return capacity - flow;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlowSolver {
        int nodes;
        List<Edge>[] graph;
        Edge[] parent;
        boolean[] mark;

        MaxFlowSolver(int sz) {
            nodes = sz;
            graph = new List[sz];
            for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
                graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            parent = new Edge[sz];
            mark = new boolean[sz];
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, int cap) {
            Edge f = new Edge(u, v, graph[v].size(), 0, cap);
            Edge r = new Edge(v, u, graph[u].size(), 0, 0);
            graph[u].add(f);
            graph[v].add(r);
        }

        void bidirectional(int u, int v, int cap) {
            Edge f = new Edge(u, v, graph[v].size(), 0, cap);
            Edge r = new Edge(v, u, graph[u].size(), 0, cap);
            graph[u].add(f);
            graph[v].add(r);
        }

        boolean findPath(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(mark, false);
            Arrays.fill(parent, null);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            mark[s] = true;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == t) return true;
                for (Edge e : graph[u]) {
                    if (!mark[e.dst] && e.remaining() > 0) {
                        mark[e.dst] = true;
                        parent[e.dst] = e;
                        q.offer(e.dst);
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int pushFlow(int s, int t) {
            int bottleneck = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v].src) {
                bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, parent[v].remaining());
            }
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v].src) {
                Edge e = parent[v];
                e.flow += bottleneck;
                graph[e.dst].get(e.backIdx).flow -= bottleneck;
            }
            return bottleneck;
        }

        long compute(int s, int t) {
            long total = 0;
            while (findPath(s, t)) {
                total += pushFlow(s, t);
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int[][] mapGrid = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] safeZone = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] toxic = new int[61][MAXN][MAXN];

    static class Agent {
        int r, c, count;

        Agent(int x, int y, int n) {
            r = x; c = y; count = n;
        }

        boolean inside(int size) {
            return r >= 0 && r < size && c >= 0 && c < size && mapGrid[r][c] == -1;
        }
    }

    static boolean ok(int x, int y, int size) {
        return new Agent(x, y, 0).inside(size);
    }

    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int parseCell(char ch) {
        if (Character.isDigit(ch)) return -1;
        if (ch == 'Y') return -2;
        if (ch == 'Z') return -3;
        return -1;
    }

    static int parseCount(char ch) {
        return ch - '0';
    }

    static int shortestPath(Agent start, Agent end, int size) {
        boolean[][] visited = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{0, start.r, start.c});
        visited[start.r][start.c] = true;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int time = cur[0];
            int r = cur[1];
            int c = cur[2];

            if (r == end.r && c == end.c) return time;
            if (toxic[time][r][c] == 1) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dr[k];
                int nc = c + dc[k];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < size && nc >= 0 && nc < size && !visited[nr][nc] && mapGrid[nr][nc] == -1 && toxic[time][nr][nc] == 0) {
                    q.offer(new int[]{time + 1, nr, nc});
                    visited[nr][nc] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static void propagateToxicity(int x, int y, int duration, int size) {
        toxic[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int t = 1; t <= duration; ++t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                    if (toxic[t-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        toxic[t][i][j] = 1;
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                            int ni = i + dr[k], nj = j + dc[k];
                            if (ni >= 0 && ni < size && nj >= 0 && nj < size && mapGrid[ni][nj] == -1) {
                                toxic[t][ni][nj] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();

        Agent hazard = new Agent(0, 0, 0);
        List<Agent> survivors = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Agent> shelters = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                String ch = sc.next();
                char c = ch.charAt(0);
                if (parseCell(c) == -1 && parseCount(c) > 0) {
                    survivors.add(new Agent(i, j, parseCount(c)));
                }
                mapGrid[i][j] = parseCell(c);
                if (mapGrid[i][j] == -3) {
                    hazard = new Agent(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                String ch = sc.next();
                char c = ch.charAt(0);
                if (parseCell(c) == -1 && parseCount(c) > 0) {
                    shelters.add(new Agent(i, j, parseCount(c)));
                    safeZone[i][j] = parseCount(c);
                }
            }
        }

        MaxFlowSolver solver = new MaxFlowSolver(MAXN);
        int sinkNode = MAXN - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < survivors.size(); ++i) {
            solver.connect(0, i*2 + 1, survivors.get(i).count);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < shelters.size(); ++i) {
            solver.connect(i*2 + 2, sinkNode, shelters.get(i).count);
        }

        propagateToxicity(hazard.r, hazard.c, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < survivors.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < shelters.size(); ++j) {
                int dist = shortestPath(survivors.get(i), shelters.get(j), N);
                if (dist <= T) {
                    solver.connect(i*2 + 1, j*2 + 2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solver.compute(0, sinkNode));
    }
}
